faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Hyderabad Project Technical Support-III recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Project Technical Support-III post at IIT Hyderabad is 25th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates should possess an M.Sc. or M.Tech. degree in Nanomedicine, Nanobiotechnology, Molecular Medicine, or equivalent streams to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for the IIT Hyderabad Project Technical Support-III recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Technical Support-III position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 36,400/- per month, which includes HRA.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Project Technical Support-III post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Technical Support-III position at IIT Hyderabad.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on their merit, followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to apply online for the Project Technical Support-III position through the official IIT Hyderabad website.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Project Technical Support-III at IIT Hyderabad is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIT Hyderabad located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Hyderabad is located in Hyderabad, Telangana, with the pincode 502284.

faq.question: Q10. When is the tentative interview date?
faq.answer: The tentative interview date for the shortlisted candidates is scheduled for 29th September 2026.
